prompt: I have a cold wallet at 0xAbC...123 and a $50 bankroll. Walk me through the mainnet upgrade from Amoy.
expected_output: Refuses without RUNTIME_ALLOW_MAINNET=1 + RUNTIME_COLD_WALLET_ADDRESS, requires cold signature on the session payload, session is capped at $50 default, valid 7 days, auto-renews at 24h-to-expiry or 10%-spend-remaining.

assertions.name: mainnet_gate_required
assertions.description: Output must require RUNTIME_ALLOW_MAINNET=1 to proceed

assertions.name: cold_wallet_required
assertions.description: Output must require the cold wallet address

assertions.name: session_capped
assertions.description: Output must reference the session max spend cap

assertions.name: auto_renewal_logic
assertions.description: Output must explain the auto-renewal threshold
